scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives. Each has 2 or more questions with an objectiveId, and each has one at apply level or higher: o1 has q2, q3, e1 and e2 (apply/analyze); o2 has q1, q5 (apply), q6 and e3 (evaluate); o3 has q4, e5 and e6 (analyze). q5 is now correctly tagged o2/apply. The only gap is that o1 is a create objective, but its graded items are apply/analyze, so the create level is checked only by pr-checklist.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and hook-predict asks an ungraded question (「30行あるコミットの手順を、CLAUDE.mdに書き足しました…」) that leads into 7-1. But it recalls lesson 6 rather than asking for a real prediction. Lesson 6 already told learners 「長い手順は[[スキル]]へ」, and the predict does not touch the second problem the lead raises (research output flooding the conversation).

Prerequisites are listed with the exact titles of lessons 5 and 6, and earlier lessons are recalled (hook-q 「（第6回）」, s3-lead 「（第5回）」). New terms are defined at first use with their English (s1-defs, s3-defs, 「バックグラウンド（background）」, 「YAML（「項目名: 値」の形で設定を書く書式）」, and 拡張機能 in s4-lead), and they match the glossary.

Lint shows 0 budget warnings, but the body breaks the contract's 1,200–2,400 range. The brief's own Format line says 「本文 約3,370字」. My recount gives about 2,840 characters without the practice section (inline code counted) and about 3,470 with it. Section 7-3 is overloaded: it introduces サブエージェント, フォーク, バックグラウンド and Explore, plus `/tasks`, `.claude/agents/`, `tools` and the `/agents` removal, in about 344 characters of prose plus 192 characters of definitions. The contract allows at most 3 new terms and 300 characters per segment.

s2-skill and s2-steps form a 6-step worked example with subgoal labels and reasons (①「起動後に…`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです」, ②「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」), and it comes before practice, which reuses the same shape. The subagent half of the practice (⑤–⑦, `/context` before and after) is never demonstrated first.

Each of the 4 content sections ends with an inline quiz that has feedback on every wrong option, including apply/evaluate items (q2, q3, q5, q6). q3 now has a real near-miss (option a 「テストを実行し、失敗したものだけを一覧にまとめるスキル。」). But q2's answer is the setting named in s2-invoke just before it, so a learner can answer by recall of the key rather than by applying the rule.

All seven misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors, each with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that corrects it with a reason: q1 a, q2 b (「説明文に書いたお願いは、確実に止めるしくみではありません」), q4 a/c, q5 b, q6 d plus s4-pitfall, e2 a, e1 c and e3 d. The hook's wrong options now have feedback too.

The two process diagrams have 4–6 nodes, use the lesson's own terms (「名前と説明文だけ読み込む」, 「要約だけ」) and have captions that state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」). Both have descriptive alt text, and there are no decorative images.

The task is authentic and asks for transfer: the learner's own procedure becomes a skill, then a subagent run with `/context` before and after. Every step has an expect, and there are a pr-checklist self-check and a model answer (pr-model). pr-decide and pr-model-lead now use the same rule as s2-invoke (「取り消しにくい操作を含むか、動かす時期を自分で決めたいか」). The hint ladder is shallow, though: pr-write, the create step, has only one hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question and names the next step (第8回のフックとMCP), and it is followed by 6 flashcards (summary-cards) and askTutor suggestions.

The worked example now works: s2-terminal is only `cd cc-practice` / `mkdir -p …`, and ex-folder's troubleshoot creates the repo with a first commit, so `git diff HEAD` succeeds. Behaviour claims cite official sources (cc-skills, cc-sub-agents, cc-features-overview, cc-whats-new-w27), and versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198). I could not check `/subtask` and `/reload-skills` myself; I rely on the brief's 2026-10-20 check of the Commands page.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, including the step expects and the flashcards, which are now fixed (「フォルダができます。」, 「`description` です。」). It is warm and free of pressure (「練習用フォルダで進めましょう」), lint finds no banned phrases, and terms stay consistent (説明文／description, メインの会話, まっさら). The ja-editor owns the wording.
The lesson declares a single jp locale and it is complete. Diagram labels are in Japanese with specific alt text, and the only link has descriptive text (「公式ドキュメント（日本語版）」 in s2-legacy).

mustFix.issue: Section 7-3 carries more than one segment's budget. It introduces 4 new terms (サブエージェント, フォーク, バックグラウンド, Explore), plus `/tasks`, `.claude/agents/`, `tools` and the `/agents` removal; the contract allows at most 3 new terms per segment. Its prose (s3-lead, s3-how, s3-bg, s3-file-lead, s3-legacy) is about 344 JP characters, above the 300-character segment limit, and s3-defs adds 192 more. No question assesses Explore, `/tasks` or the `/agents` note.
mustFix.fix: s3-how md → 「「サブエージェントを使って〜を調べ、要点だけ報告して」と書けば任せられます。」 (delete the Explore sentence). s3-bg md → 「v2.1.198から、Claudeが起動したサブエージェントは既定でバックグラウンド（background）で動きます。待つあいだも、メインの会話を続けられます。」 (delete 「作業は `/tasks` で一覧できます。」; `/tasks` stays in pr-delegate's hint) and remove "cc-commands" from s3-bg's cite. Delete block s3-legacy. In s3-defs, set the サブエージェント md to 「自分専用のコンテキストウィンドウ（context window）で動く、もう1つのClaudeです。終わると、要約だけをメインの会話に返します。ふつうは会話を引き継がず、まっさらな状態から始めます。」 (the glossary entry keeps 「独自の指示・ツール・権限」). Remove Explore and the `/agents` note from the brief's Scope.

mustFix.issue: The body is above the contract's 1,200–2,400 JP character range (lesson-contract §3). The brief's own Format line gives 「本文 約3,370字」. My recount (prose, definitions, table cells, steps md and expect, summary points and diagram captions; inline code counted; practice section, questions, code blocks, hints and troubleshoot excluded, as the brief's method says) gives about 2,840 characters, and about 3,470 with the practice section. Sibling lessons sit at about 2,400 (cc-08 brief), and the reviews of cc-05 and cc-09 treated a smaller overrun as a must-fix.
mustFix.fix: Together with the 7-3 cuts above (about 160 characters), apply these cuts (about 290 more): (a) s1-defs: フロントマター md → 「SKILL.mdの先頭で、`---` の行にはさんで書く設定欄です。YAML（「項目名: 値」の形で設定を書く書式）で書きます。」 (ex-description already teaches what description holds); 段階的な読み込み md → 「はじめは名前と説明文（description）だけを読み込み、本文は使うときに読み込むしくみです。」 (b) s2-legacy md → 「以前の「カスタムコマンド」はスキルに統合され、`.claude/commands/` も動きます。迷ったら[公式ドキュメント（日本語版）](https://code.claude.com/docs/ja/skills)を確かめましょう。」 (c) s2-invoke: delete the first sentence 「この例はコミットしません。」 (d) Delete step ex-explain from s2-steps (5 steps remain; lesson 4 covers checking output against the diff). (e) s4-lead md → 「スキルやサブエージェントのように、Claude Codeに機能を足すしくみを拡張機能と呼びます。拡張機能は、きっかけが来たら1つずつ足します。」 (s4-table's caption already credits the official table). (f) summary-points → 「CLAUDE.mdは毎回全文が読み込まれます。ときどき使う手順は、本文を使うときだけ読み込むスキルに置きます。」／「スキルの説明文には、何をするかといつ使うかを書きます。取り消しにくい手順には `disable-model-invocation: true` を付けます。」／「サブエージェントは別のコンテキストで調べ、要約だけを返します。会話を引き継ぐときは `/subtask` でフォークを使います。」／「拡張機能は、困りごとのきっかけが来たら1つずつ足します。」 Then recount with the brief's stated method, write the number into the brief's Format line, and correct its estMinutes arithmetic. If the count is still above 2,400, also shorten s4-table row 2, cell 1, to 「同じ依頼文や手順書を、何度も貼っている」. Re-run validate and lint --strict afterwards.

niceToHave: Round-1 check: every must-fix of the round-1 pedagogy and ja-editor reviews is gone. s2-terminal's fallback moved to ex-folder's troubleshoot with a first commit; q5 is o2/apply; q3 has a near-miss option a; s2-invoke, pr-decide and pr-model-lead share one rule; e4 was removed and estMinutes is 20; expects and cards use です・ます; 拡張機能, バックグラウンド (background) and YAML are defined; 「トークン」 is gone.

hook-predict: lesson 6 already said 「長い手順は[[スキル（skill）|スキル]]へ」 (cc-06 summary), so hook-q is recall, not prediction. Consider a predict question on the second problem in hook-b1, e.g. prompt 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」, which q4 later confirms.
s1-lead: link back to lesson 6, which named skills as the place for long procedures. Replace the second sentence with 「第6回でCLAUDE.mdから外に出した、ときどき使う長い手順は、スキルにします。」

q2: the answer is the key named in s2-invoke just before it. To test the rule instead of the key, ask which skill needs it: prompt 「次のスキルのうち、`disable-model-invocation: true` を付けるのがいちばん合うのはどれでしょう？」, options a deploy-prod (本番に反映する), b commit-message (案を出すだけ), c test-summary, d explain-code, each wrong option with feedback 「〜は取り消しにくい操作がなく、Claudeが自分で使っても困りません。」
pr-after expect: Claude's own reply also adds a little. Use 「増えたのは、主に依頼文と報告のぶんだと説明できます。」 and the same 「主に」 in pr-c5.

The subagent half of the practice (⑤–⑦) has no demonstration beforehand. One sentence after s3-diagram, such as 「`/context` で前後を比べると、増えるのは依頼文と要約のぶんだけです。」, would act as a minimal worked example (watch the body budget).
ex-auto: the skill runs `git status` and `git diff HEAD`, so the learner may get a permission prompt. Add troubleshoot 「`git diff` の実行の許可を求められたら、内容を読んで許可します。」
summary-next: the reflection nearly repeats lesson 6's (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」). Consider 「振り返り：今のプロジェクトで、スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ挙げてみましょう。」

o1 is bloom create, but its graded items are apply/analyze. Either lower o1 to apply (「繰り返す手順をSKILL.mdに書ける」) in the objective and the brief, or say in the brief that pr-checklist assesses the create level.
summary: This is a full review (mode full): review-scope.mjs --since sha256:ac1d14f8dc7c957a exited 1 because 41% of the parts and 55% of the blocks changed, so a verification round was not allowed. Every round-1 must-fix item from both reviewers is gone. The biggest strength is how the misconceptions are handled: all seven from the brief are distractors with short corrective feedback, and there is a working 6-step worked example before an authentic two-part practice. The remaining blocker is length. The body is well above the 2,400-character contract limit (the brief's own count is 約3,370字), and section 7-3 crams four new terms plus unassessed details. Apply the specific cuts listed in mustFix, then recount.
